figurative_meaning_en: A child who illuminates the family's reputation
similar_in_english: A shining star in the family
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ছেলে বংশের বাতি হয়ে উঠেছে, সবাই গর্বিত।
এই পরিবারের বংশের বাতি তার মেয়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: His son has become the light of the family, making everyone proud.
In this family, his daughter is the one who brightens the lineage.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali emphasis on familial legacy and achievement.
